user.title: ORVIBO Smart Control - HomeMate Login
user.description: Enter your HomeMate account (phone number or email) and password

select_family.title: Select Family
select_family.description: Multiple families found, select one to manage

devices.title: Select Devices
devices.description: Devices are grouped by type. Open a group to select devices. Groups with multiple devices include a select-all option; single-device groups can be selected directly.

area.title: Assign Area
area.description: Select HA area for {device} ({position}/{total}). The room from HomeMate is {room}. Leave empty for no area.

error.invalid_username: Invalid phone number or email format
error.no_devices: No devices found in this family

abort.reauth_entry_missing: The configuration entry no longer exists

transport_mode.title: Transport mode
transport_mode.description: Combined (default): LAN-first with cloud fallback. LAN only: no cloud realtime connection or periodic cloud polling after initial discovery. Cloud only: do not connect to MixPad.

lan_credentials.title: Independent MixPad LAN credentials
lan_credentials.description: Enable only when MixPad uses another account. The password is stored as a protocol digest; leave it blank to keep an existing value.

sync_device_names.title: Sync cloud device names
sync_device_names.description: Update integration-provided Home Assistant device names from ORVIBO cloud. User-defined names are preserved.

clear_local_data.title: Clear local data
clear_local_data.description: Deletes only this integration's local lock media directory and optionally resets general options. Account, family, selected devices, entity registry, and Home Assistant .storage are preserved.

data.reset_general_options: Reset transport, LAN credentials, polling, notification, and update options

polling.title: Cloud polling interval
polling.description: Fallback cloud snapshot polling interval in minutes. LAN-only mode does not perform periodic cloud polling.

availability_notifications.title: Device availability notifications
availability_notifications.description: Notify only after a selected device actually changes online state. Leave the service blank to use persistent notifications.

update_check.title: Integration update check
update_check.description: Periodically check the latest stable GitHub release and create one persistent notification when an update is available.

reauth.title: Sign in again
reauth.description: Enter the new password for {username}. Your family, devices, entities, and area assignments will be preserved.

lock_users.title: Lock user mapping
lock_users.description: One entry per line: userID=name (e.g. 1=John, 2=Jane). Used to show who opened the door.

device_name_filter.title: Hide devices by name
device_name_filter.description: Enter one name keyword or wildcard pattern per line. Keywords match any part of a device name; wildcards support *, ?, and character ranges such as [0-9]. Matching devices are hidden from Home Assistant and the device selection page. Remove a rule to show them again.

devices.title: Select Devices
devices.description: Devices are grouped by type. Open a group to select devices. Groups with multiple devices include a select-all option; single-device groups can be selected directly.

area.title: Assign Area
area.description: Select HA area for {device} ({position}/{total}). ORVIBO room is {room}.

error.auth_failed: Login failed, check the new password
error.no_devices: No devices found in this family
error.no_visible_devices: All discovered devices are hidden by the name rules
error.lan_credentials_required: Enter the independent MixPad username and password
error.invalid_service: Use a service in domain.service format

abort.reauth_successful: Signed in successfully; existing device and entity settings were preserved
abort.device_names_synced: Cloud device names synchronized. Updated {count} Home Assistant devices
abort.local_data_cleared: Local integration data cleared. Removed {count} files

options.auto: LAN and cloud (default, LAN first with cloud fallback)
options.lan_only: LAN only (runtime state and control use MixPad only)
options.cloud_only: Cloud only (do not connect to MixPad LAN)
